mostWorthwhile.text: Completing the private desk was most worthwhile: receipts, privacy controls and a pencil option made user choice tangible rather than just a promise.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the printer and tablet separately to the controller was somewhat repetitive, especially after I expected them to connect directly.

surprise.text: The printer needed the local controller rather than a direct tablet connection; the tablet also had to connect to the controller before the two could form a desk.

arbitrary.text: The controller connections were not initially obvious, although the results explained their role in the local queue. I was also unsure why Moth was needed until the optional-help result.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the neighborhood uses its locally controlled infrastructure; the concrete privacy choices and Sal's response made this chapter engaging.
